# Anastasiia Sukhanek (Анастасия Суханек)

> Senior product designer in Prague, open to remote roles worldwide. 8 years in design: fintech, telecom, e-commerce. Designs the moments where people decide to keep going or give up – payments, verification, error states – and measures the result. Builds design systems in Figma and in code (tokens, React, Storybook). Czech permanent residence, no visa sponsorship needed. English B2, Russian native

Pronunciation: Su-KHA-nek, stress on the «a» (Суха́нек)

## Looking for

- Senior Product Designer role in fintech, payments or any product with tricky flows, with a team that looks at the numbers
- Remote worldwide or in Prague

## Experience

- Profee (remittance app, iOS, Android, web), Product Designer reporting to the head of design, March 2025 – now
- Beeline (telecom loyalty), Product Designer, August 2023 – January 2025
- SberSpasibo (Sber loyalty programme), Lead Designer, January 2022 – August 2023

## Case studies

- [KYC verification: from email to app](https://anastasiia-suhanek.github.io/case-profee-verification.html): 10 verification entry points rebuilt as one design system component, −54% verification questions to support
- [Transfer statuses](https://anastasiia-suhanek.github.io/case-profee-statuses.html): an Updates timeline for transfers, ~70% tap “Continue transfer” within a day
- [Profee Cards](https://anastasiia-suhanek.github.io/case-profee-cards.html): Cards area rebuilt on iOS and Android, ×2 active senders open the Cards tab
- [Top up in the transfer](https://anastasiia-suhanek.github.io/case-profee-topup.html): a Top up button right in the payment step, ×3.3 more senders top up on Android
- [Gamification at Sber](https://anastasiia-suhanek.github.io/case-sber-spasibo.html): games and tasks in the SberSpasibo loyalty programme, up to ×3 bonus redemption
